metadata.description: Collection of plugins for creating Claude Code extensions and building production-grade agentic workflows

plugins.name: agentic-flow-builder
plugins.description: Build dynamic agentic workflows using ReAcTree hierarchical decomposition, business rules engine for deterministic gates, and Anthropic's workflow patterns with full audit trails

plugins.name: prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Expert prompt optimization for LLMs and AI systems. Proactively improves prompts using proven techniques, patterns, and model-specific optimization. Uses Opus for advanced reasoning.

plugins.name: prd-quality-gate-flow
plugins.description: Production-grade PRD (Product Requirements Document) workflow system with 7 quality gates, business rules engine for deterministic decisions, episodic memory, and complete audit trails. Implements evidence-based Stage-Gate process with 60% defect reduction and 138% ROI.

plugins.name: research-agent
plugins.description: Production-grade research agent with auto-detection of 5 research types (Exploratory, Descriptive, Explanatory, Evaluative, Comparative), academic frameworks (PICO, SPICE, PECO, GRADE, ReAct), systematic review protocol, root cause analysis patterns (5 Whys + Fishbone), and prompt-engineered research patterns for source-backed, bias-aware investigations.

plugins.name: delivery-team
plugins.description: Full delivery team with 11 specialized skills covering the complete software delivery lifecycle. Delivery Flow (pipeline orchestrator with session keepalive, shared constraints.yml, configurable Architecture Board, Transformation Planning sub-workflow for brownfield migrations), Product Delivery (PO, Scrum Bag, Data Analyst), Developer (14 languages + OOP + FP patterns + frontend + Nx monorepo), Godot (game dev), Architect (11 roles + game architecture + 4 architecture decomposition strategies + paradigm-as-skill router + AS-IS/TO-BE/Roadmap transformation planning), Quality (QA with Feature Knowledge System), Operations (DevOps, Release Manager, Tech Writer), UI (UX, UI, Game UI), Alias Creator (alias themes), User Feedback (simulated persona-based testing with 20+ built-in personas across gamers, web users, enterprise, and demographics), and Presentation Composer (team-collaborative presentations).

plugins.name: mtg-commander
plugins.description: MTG Commander deck builder with multi-agent pipeline and adversarial challenger agents. Each primary step (Deck Builder, Rules Judge, Optimizer, Price Evaluator) is verified by a dedicated challenger in an independent correction loop. Synergy-first card selection via Scryfall API, format legality validation, structural optimization, budget enforcement with price goal escalation, and configurable loop caps via `.mtg-commander.yml`. Produces complete 100-card decklists.

plugins.name: hardware-team
plugins.description: Hardware delivery team with 8-stage pipeline orchestrator for structured hardware product development. Coordinates 6 hardware roles (HW Product Owner, Electrical Engineer, PCB Layout Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Compliance Engineer, Test Engineer) through concept-to-production pipeline. Consumes kicad-happy skills for component sourcing, fabrication, analysis, and documentation.
